profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full stack software developer with over 15 yrs experience in a wide range of industries. 

My experiences range from developing T/E tracking applications, State E-Procurement software and cross-browser web applications. I enjoy working with teams and listening to end-user needs, to produce high quality applications.

I enjoy working on long term projects and developing long term business relationships.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer managing and enhancing in house marketing CMS applications all written in .NET C#, MVC, .NET CORE 6.0, Angular JS
•	Cloud Integration with Azure
•	CI/CD process used Azure DevOps, with GIT repository and Pipeline
•	REST API development and consumption on web app and mobile app
•	Agile Scrum process to deliver on time projects
•	CMS enhancements using Kentico and Marketing Automation
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Software Industry

positions.title: Software Developer/Content Author
positions.description:
•	Software Engineer managing and enhancing our in house customer service application, warranty registration, dealer portal.
•	Maintain and upgrade consumer website using Kentico CRM connected to AWS, Jenkins, Angular JS
•	Maintain and upgrade consumer website using AEM (Adobe Enterprise Management System)
•	Working with third party development agency to complete projects in a timely manner.
•	SQL Reporting with SSIS and SSRS for customer service dept
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Programming · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Technical Architecture · Product Requirements · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kentico

positions.title: IT Developer/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Software Engineer working on in house LMS application, Rep tracking system, and mobile application
•	Using Xamarin Forms with Visual Studio 2015, debugged and enhanced mobile application, contacting to SQL 2014 database utilizing AWS and XML files to capture data
•	Re-architect the current LMS application moving from a web form application to MVC application, HTML 5, AJAX, .Net
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Programming · Technical Architecture · Product Requirements

positions.title: Web Site Developer
positions.description:
•	Website Developer working on web application using ASP.NET C#
•	Developed, Tested and Maintain applications using ASP.NET C# WCF, Azure, MVC applications for Randstad Clients
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Programming · Technical Architecture

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Senior Software Engineer/Manager for LHC Solutions - Managed team of 50 helpdesk engineers as part of Dell’s Professional Service Partner
•	Planned and Redesigned E-procurement system for Sicomm.net This application is currently in use by the State of Hawaii, State of New Mexico using Asp.net and SQL 2012
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Technical Architecture · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Senior Software Engineer/Manager for LHC Solutions.  Managed team of 50 helpdesk engineers as part of Dell’s Professional service partner.  
•	Planned and Redesigned E-procurement system for Sicomm.net.  This application is currently in use by the State of Hawaii, State of New Mexico using Asp.net and SQL 2012
•	Planned, Designed and maintain web Employee Time and Expense System and Company portal using ASP.NET (C#) connecting to a SQL 2008 Database.   Started migration to MVC 2.0
•	Developed, tested and maintain applications using ASP.NET C# WCF, Azure, MVC applications for PFI Clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Technical Architecture · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Software Engineer for Balboa Instruments
•	Developed and maintain and QC web projection report system using ASP.NET (VB.NET) connecting to a SQL Database for sales team.
•	Developed and maintain web application using ASP.NET C#/ T-SQL for physical inventory count.  
•	Using VB6 and VB.NET debug and revise in house RMA application.
•	Tested varies web applications interfacing with MAS 200 using Lean Development
